analysis.overall: It was a challenging 24 hours marked by frequent swings, including a late-night high following midnight carbs and a stubborn low that persisted through the morning.

events.title: Early afternoon low
events.description: Glucose dropped to a low of 55 mg/dL before being brought back up with a 25g carb meal.

events.title: Late afternoon spike
events.description: A small carb snack paired with multiple stacked correction doses caused glucose to climb to 190 mg/dL before coming down.

events.title: Evening drop
events.description: Levels steadily drifted down to 59 mg/dL, prompting a temporary target set to prevent a deeper fall.

events.title: Overnight high after midnight meal
events.description: A 40g carb meal around midnight led to a persistent overnight surge peaking at 217 mg/dL despite frequent automated correction boluses.

events.title: Extended morning low
events.description: After finally bringing down the overnight high, glucose lingered in the 55-60 mg/dL range for over two hours into the morning.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Late-night carbs led to a long overnight high followed by a extended morning low, so keep an eye on late snack timing and correction boluses.
